items.excerpt: Bulgaria will face another day of dangerous heat on Wednesday, August 12, with the National Institute of Meteorology and Hydrology (NIMH) issuing a yellow weather warning for high temperatures across the entire country.
items.originalTitle: Dangerous Heat to Sweep Bulgaria on Wednesday
